en_title: 'Go Play GTA 6, We Need to Detox,' Wardogs Developer Tells Fans as It Prepares to Take December Off
cn_title: 「去玩《GTA6》吧，我们需要清净一下」：《战狗》开发商准备休息整个12月，对粉丝如是说
opus_summary: 《战狗》开发商Bulkhead计划整个12月休假，为新一年及游戏1.0版本的推出养精蓄锐。CEO Joe Brammer表示，希望玩家也能休息，去玩《GTA6》。此前，《战狗》推出了多次更新，第二赛季的上线表现令人失望。

paragraphs.en: After the runaway success of Wardogs , a new sandbox multiplayer shooter in Early Access on PC, the team at Bulkhead is taking a well-deserved break — and they want you to know you can take a break, too.
paragraphs.cn: 在PC抢先体验阶段的全新沙盒多人射击游戏《战狗》大获成功后，Bulkhead团队将迎来当之无愧的休息——他们也想让你知道，你同样可以休息一下。

paragraphs.en: It’s a break the team likely needs. Since launch, there’s been balance patch after balance patch, hotfixes, major updates, and small updates. Wardogs even saw some controversy when it attempted to region lock players to prevent cheating.
paragraphs.cn: 团队或许确实需要这次休息。自游戏上线以来，平衡补丁接连推出，还有热修复、大型更新和小型更新。《战狗》试图对玩家实施区域锁定以防止作弊时，甚至引发了一些争议。

paragraphs.en: Speaking to Edge Magazine, via GamesRadar , Bulkhead CEO Joe Brammer explained the pressure the team had been dealing with. "Everyone has done something that's not in their job description,” Brammer said. “Everyone wears multiple hats, because they can see the path to success with the product."
paragraphs.cn: 据GamesRadar报道，Bulkhead首席执行官Joe Brammer在接受Edge Magazine采访时解释了团队一直面临的压力。Brammer说：「每个人都做过职责范围之外的事情。每个人都身兼数职，因为他们能看到这款产品通往成功的道路。」

paragraphs.en: Following a flurry of updates and a disappointing Wardogs Season 2 launch , Bulkhead is taking the whole month of December off to rest and refresh for the new year and the road to the game’s 1.0 launch.
paragraphs.cn: 在一连串更新以及令人失望的《战狗》第二赛季上线之后，Bulkhead将在整个12月休假，以休息和调整状态，迎接新的一年以及游戏通往1.0正式上线的征程。

paragraphs.en: "We're going to make sure players know they can f**k off in December," he said. "Go play GTA 6 , we need to detox.”
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「我们会确保玩家知道，他们12月可以滚去干别的。去玩《GTA6》吧，我们需要清净一下。」

paragraphs.en: It’s a refreshing approach to hear a developer acknowledge the incoming leviathan that is Rockstar’s open-world crime sequel. Most publishers are just quietly changing their plans with no outward communication, but Bulkhead addressed the massive, massive elephant filling the room.
paragraphs.cn: 听到一家开发商正视Rockstar即将推出的开放世界犯罪游戏续作这一庞然大物，是一种令人耳目一新的做法。大多数发行商只是悄悄改变计划，没有对外沟通，但Bulkhead谈及了这个占满整个房间、无比庞大的显而易见的问题。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is out on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox, and it is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all time. A number of publishers and developers either worked to release their games beforehand, leading to the September crunch, or push them back into early 2027. Star Citizen chief Chris Roberts claimed he delayed spinoff Squadron 42 into next year because he didn't want it going up against the "attention buzz saw of GTA 6."
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将于11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX，预计将成为有史以来规模最大的娱乐产品发布。多家发行商和开发商要么努力在此之前推出游戏，导致了9月的扎堆发行，要么将游戏推迟到2027年初。《Star Citizen》负责人Chris Roberts称，他将衍生作品《Squadron 42》延期至明年，是因为他不希望它与「《GTA6》吸引注意力的锯刃」正面交锋。

paragraphs.en: "While GTA 6 isn’t launching on PC this November, pretty much all outlets and most content creators will be all over it, not leaving a lot of room for other coverage," Roberts continued.
paragraphs.cn: Roberts继续说道：「虽然《GTA6》不会在今年11月登陆PC，但几乎所有媒体和大多数内容创作者都会全面关注它，不会给其他报道留下太多空间。」

paragraphs.en: Analysts expect GTA 6 will make over $5 billion in launch week alone , so expect it to fill your feeds for a few weeks.
paragraphs.cn: 分析师预计，《GTA6》仅在发售首周的收入就将超过50亿美元，因此预计它会在接下来几周占满你的信息流。
